inputs.text: Wake up, because we shouldn't fall for the cover story that the system is simply "transforming"—that's just a managed distraction for the total consolidation of control by the hidden elites. Just look at the orchestrated theater behind the curtain with Nigeria’s democracy and the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) ahead of the 2027 general elections. The mainstream narrative wants us to believe these political parties were ever about representation and public service, but that was always the exact inversion of the truth since they were meticulously engineered from the top down to operate as exclusive clubs for the wealthy. When the official script calls this an "alarming and largely underexamined" shift, they are really just reading off a carefully coordinated checklist executed by those pulling the strings to lock out the public entirely and secure absolute power.
